description: Gets the entity attribute values. This should only be used inside LINQ statements when building a where clause for the query. This property should only be used inside LINQ statements for filtering or selecting values. Do not use it for accessing the attributes after the entity has been loaded.
A collection containing the AI Agent Skill entities that represent the skills attached to this agent.
The type of agent represented by this instance. This is a hard coded list of values defined in the code as an enumeration.
The type of audience that this agent is intended for. This is a hard coded list of values defined in the code as an enumeration.
The binary file that contains the image to use as the avatar to represent the agent. This will be used in the administrative UI and the chat UI to represent the agent visually.
The identifier of the binary file that contains the image to use as the avatar to represent the agent. This will be used in the administrative UI and the chat UI to represent the agent visually.
The description of the agent, which provides additional context or information about its intended purpose and functionality.

When AgentType is Rock.Enums.AI.Agent.AgentType.Chat, this contains the instructions for the agent, which is a string that describes how the agent should behavor or respond. This can include tone, style, and special instructions it should follow when interacting with people. When AgentType is Rock.Enums.AI.Agent.AgentType.Mcp, this contains the instructions that should be sent when a client connects to the MCP server.
The friendly name of the agent that will be used to identify it in the UI.
The agent that the session is associated with.
The identifier of the agent that the session is associated with.
A collection containing the AI Agent Session Anchor entities that represent the anchors that provide context to the session.
A collection containing the AI Agent Session History entities that represent the chat history records for this session.
The date and time the session was last used. This should be updated whenever a new message is added to the session history table. This will be set automatically when the session is first created.
An optional name for the session. This can be used to help identify this session later. If no name is specified then the date should be used as a way to identify the session in the UI.
The the PersonAlias that owns this session. This is used to ensure that a person cannot view another person's chat history.
The identifier of the PersonAlias that owns this session. This is used to ensure that a person cannot view another person's chat history.
The type of session represented by this instance. This is a hard coded list of values defined in the code as an enumeration.
The date and time the session was started. This will be set automatically when the session is created.
The session that the history is associated with.
The identifier of the session that the anchor is associated with.
The date and time the anchor was added to the session. This will be set automatically when the anchor is created.
The identifier of the entity that this anchor is associated with.
The entity type that EntityId is referring to.
The identifier of the entity type that EntityId is referring to.
Indicates whether the anchor is currently active. An anchor that is not active will not be sent to the language model.
The date and time the payload was last refreshed. This is used to automatically refresh the payload after a period of time. This is required since the referenced entity might have changed.
The name of the entity that this anchor is associated with. This is used to help identify the anchor in the UI. It may not always be in sync with the actual entity.
The JSON payload that contains the context for the anchor. This exact contents will vary based on the entity type.
The date and time the anchor was removed from the session. This will be set automatically when the anchor is made inactive.
The session that the history is associated with.
The identifier of the session that the history is associated with.

The number of tokens that were consumed by the entire request sent to the language model. This is only relevant for messages that were returned by the language model, not user messages. This may be 0 if the token count could not be determined.
Indicates whether the message is currently in context for the session. A message that is in context is included in the chat history and can be used to generate new responses.

Indicates whether the message is a summary of the session. This is used when the chat history grows too large and must be summarized to stay relevant. Only one summary message should be marked as IsCurrentlyInContext.
The text content of the message.
The date and time the message was posted.

The role of the message in the session chat history. This is used to determine if this was a message from the individual, a response from the agent, or some other message type. This is a hard coded list of values defined in the code as an enumeration.
The number of tokens used for the message. This may be an estimate depending on the type of message. This may be 0 if the token count could not be determined.
The agent that the skill is associated with.
The identifier of the agent that the skill is associated with.
The skill that the agent is associated with.
The identifier of the skill that the agent is associated with.

Gets or sets whether this chat channel is always shown in the channel list even if the person has not joined the channel. This also implies that the channel may be joined by any person via the chat application. If set to null, then the value of GroupType.IsChatChannelAlwaysShown will be used. This should only be used when editing the group. Call the GetIsChatChannelAlwaysShown() method instead to determine if the chat channel is always shown, as that method will also check the GroupType.IsChatChannelAlwaysShown property.

Gets or sets whether this chat channel is public. A public channel is visible to everyone when performing a search. This also implies that the channel may be joined by any person via the chat application. If set to null, then the value of GroupType.IsChatChannelPublic will be used. This should only be used when editing the group. Call the GetIsChatChannelPublic() method instead to determine if the chat channel is public, as that method will also check the GroupType.IsChatChannelPublic property.

Gets or sets whether chat is enabled for this group. If set to false (or if the parent GroupType.IsChatAllowed is set to false), then the group will not have chat enabled. If set to true, then it will have chat enabled. If set to null, then the value from GroupType.IsChatEnabledForAllGroups will be used. This should only be used when editing the group. Call the GetIsChatEnabled() method instead to determine if the group is being used for chat, as that method will also check the GroupType.IsChatAllowed and GroupType.IsChatEnabledForAllGroups properties.

Gets or sets whether individuals are allowed to leave this chat channel. If set to false, then they will only be allowed to mute the channel. If set to true, then they will be allowed to both leave and mute the channel. If set to null, then the value of GroupType.IsLeavingChatChannelAllowed will be used. This should only be used when editing the group. Call the GetIsLeavingChatChannelAllowed() method instead to determine if leaving is allowed, as that method will also check the GroupType.IsLeavingChatChannelAllowed property.
